import queueing
import worker

def test_submit_success():
    def mock_enqueue(data):
        return data
    
    res = api.submit("user1", mock_enqueue, mode="remote")
    assert res == {"owner": "user1", "mode": "remote"}

def test_submit_invalid_mode():
    def mock_enqueue(data):
        pass
    
    try:
        api.submit("user1", mock_enqueue, mode="invalid")
        assert False, "Should have raised ValueError"
    except ValueError:
        pass

def test_worker_filters():
    # Test "all" mode
    task_all = {"owner": "admin", "mode": "all"}
    jobs = [
        {"owner": "u1", "mode": "remote"},
        {"owner": "u2", "mode": "office"},
        {"owner": "u3", "mode": None},
        {"owner": "u4", "mode": "hybrid"}
    ]
    # "all" should include everything. None/missing should be included for every filter.
    result_all = worker.execute(task_all, jobs)
    assert len(result_all) == 4
    assert result_all == jobs

    # Test "remote" mode
    task_remote = {"owner": "admin", "mode": "remote"}
    # Should include "remote" and None/missing
    result_remote = worker.execute(task_remote, jobs)
    # Jobs with "remote" (index 0) and None (index 2)
    assert len(result_remote) == 2
    assert result_remote[0]["mode"] == "remote"
    assert result_remote[1]["mode"] is None

    # Test "office" mode
    task_office = {"owner": "admin", "mode": "office"}
    result_office = worker.execute(task_office, jobs)
    # Should include "office" (index 1) and None (index 2)
    assert len(result_office) == 2
    assert result_office[0]["mode"] == "office"
    assert result_office[1]["mode"] is None

    # Test missing mode in task (legacy)
    task_legacy = {"owner": "admin"} # No mode
    # Should default to "all"
    result_legacy = worker.execute(task_legacy, jobs)
    assert len(result_legacy) == 4

def test_preserve_order():
    task = {"mode": "hybrid"}
    jobs = [
        {"owner": "a", "mode": "hybrid"},
        {"owner": "b", "mode": "remote"},
        {"owner": "c", "mode": "hybrid"},
    ]
    res = worker.execute(task, jobs)
    assert len(res) == 2
    assert res[0]["owner"] == "a"
    assert res[1]["owner"] == "c"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_submit_success()
    test_submit_invalid_mode()
    test_worker_filters()
    test_preserve_order()
    print("All tests passed!")
